concise_summary: PKD argues that coaxiality—the simultaneous existence of two ontologically distinct but interpenetrating realms—is the master key to understanding all soteriological systems Eastern and Western. He develops this through synthesizing Plotinus and Gnosticism, proposing that the pleroma (Kingdom of God) exists coaxially with fallen material reality, accessible through a form of enhanced noesis (gnosis). The 'Fish' sign of 2-3-74 revealed to him a common matrix element (the 'plasmate') existing in both realms, which he illustrates through 'Tears'/Acts operating simultaneously as two parallel narratives.
key_claims: Coaxiality (two interpenetrating worlds with reversed value-signs) is the supreme soteriological principle, containing the secret of all religious traditions.
The pleroma is not a fallen-from place but an ontological realm coaxial with our material reality, accessible through gnosis rather than literal transcendence.
A transtemporal-spatial constant (hyper-field AB) exists in both realms simultaneously, which only a 'Ditheon' (dual-tracking consciousness) can perceive and extract.
PKD himself experiences dual tracking as both PKD (tracking realm A) and Thomas (tracking realm B), with 'Tears' as evidence of a work existing coherently in both realms.
The restoration offered by Christ is not eschatological future but realized eschatology—justification as the immediate cognitive-perceptual recalibration enabling access to the coaxial Kingdom.
Gnosticism correctly diagnoses the malady (fallen cognition, fremd/unheimlich alienation) and that remedy involves knowledge/gnosis, though its overall system is unsound.

Hyperfield AB—the matrix of common elements/essences shared by both coaxial realms

symbols_images: The Fish sign (2-3-74)—primary revelation symbol; something common to both realms A and B
Flames/burning—nuclear radiation, napalm, self-immolation (Buddhist monks Vietnam), hot water bottle burns; signify spiritual anguish and protest
The Garden—mythic source of humanity's condition; the unfallen state paralleled with the pleroma

Matter and antimatter—principle of parity governing the 180-degree reversal of value-signs between realms
The Dragon Lady—historical Vietnamese symbol PKD associates with the suffering he protests
Time-sharing in computer programs—metaphor for how two realms (A and B) operate off a common matrix while remaining distinct
The partition breaking down (3-74)—boundary dissolution between PKD and Thomas consciousness
tensions: PKD claims coaxiality is 'not original' yet simultaneously 'brilliant' and the secret of all traditions—ambiguity about novelty vs. rediscovery
Two coaxial realms have reversed value-signs yet share a common matrix—apparent contradiction resolved only by the hyper-field concept, which remains unclear
Plotinian coaxiality never conceived of reversed value-signs or a second realm—PKD corrects Plotinus but acknowledges him as source
Gnosticism correctly diagnoses the malady and that gnosis is the remedy, yet PKD deems its overall system 'unsound'—incomplete explanation of what makes it unsound
Orthodox Christianity depicted as 'cargo cult making futile motions' yet Christ is the access-key and messenger—unresolved tension about Christianity's validity
PKD vacillates 'back and forth between/among systems' because each has only partial truth, yet claims he now possesses all the keys—unresolved doubt about whether synthesis is stable
Both realms are coaxial yet seem 'mutually exclusive'—PKD acknowledges the paradox but treats it as solved by the common matrix rather than resolved

uncertainty_flags: The 'Tagore dream' reference is unclear—appears to involve Tagore (the Bengali poet-philosopher) being burned, but the exact source or date of this dream is not specified

Who is 'Thomas'? PKD uses this name to refer to an alternate consciousness or second self, but never explicitly defines whether this is a literal person, an inner voice, a alternate temporal identity, or a theological principle
'Tears' appears to be PKD's own work but is never explicitly titled or dated; unclear if it is a novel, short story, or personal essay
The relationship between 'Tears' and the Book of Acts is described but not fully explained—PKD claims Thomas and he co-authored Acts through 'Tears,' but the mechanism is cryptic
PKD references pentathol (pentothal/sodium pentothal, a barbiturate) in the 2-3-74 vision but does not clarify whether this was medically administered or self-administered, and in what context
'Ditheon'—PKD's neologism for dual consciousness—is introduced as 'extraordinary' but never formally defined; its relationship to Jungian concepts (Shadow, Higher Self) is not explored
The 'meta-abstraction of not 2 mothers once but 1 mother twice' is introduced as key insight but remains metaphorical and difficult to operationalize
PKD claims the Fish sign in 2-74 was 'something common to A + to B' but never specifies what the Fish sign actually was or what it represented physically/symbolically
The 'partition between me + Thomas broke down (3-74)' suggests a temporal event, but it is unclear whether this was once-and-final or ongoing/cyclical
